toast.$description: Transient top-docked notification — 'Betslip loaded', 'Betslip cleared' (Undo), 'Quick Bet mode active', 'Share link copied'. New to the system. A floating surface-6 pill lifted off the page with elevation.sm; a status icon, a semibold heading and an OPTIONAL secondary line. Two independent axes: content (one line = heading only · two lines = heading + secondary) and trailing control (none · close × · Undo action · auto-dismiss timer — and the timer combines with either button). Roles success/warning/negative/neutral change only the icon colour (and the timer tint); the glyph itself is passed per toast. Quick-Bet toasts are just plain toasts with a close and a bolt/bolt-off icon — not a separate component. The `global` kind is the solid full-bleed app-wide bar (moved here from Alert — it is a toast, not an inline banner). Distinct from Alert: Alert is a persistent in-flow banner tied to state; Toast is brief, self-dismissing, and stacks.

bg.$description: surface.floating (surface-6) — the semantic role for a surface that floats above the card/raised stack, lifted by the shadow rather than a border.

shadow.$description: The small floating-panel shadow (same weight as Popover/Menu) — a toast lifts off the page, so it carries a shadow, not a border.

paddingY.$description: 12px vertical (symmetric — content is vertically centred, single- or two-line).

gap.$description: 10px between icon, body and trailing control.

heading.$description: 14px semibold — the toast headline. The standard heading style (not a bespoke bold 'title'); on a one-line toast this is the whole message.

role.$description: Status colours: the leading-icon colour and the timer tint. success = positive (green), warning = warning (gold), negative = negative (red), neutral = secondary grey. The icon GLYPH is chosen per toast (a success toast can carry a check or, for Quick Bet, a bolt) — the role only colours it.

action.$description: The trailing Undo button IS the Button component, primary variant at base (40px) size — its size/label/colours are resolved from tokens/components/button.tokens.json at build time, never re-declared here (so it stays byte-identical to a real primary button).

hoverFill.$description: The ghost Button's hover fill — the × is a ghost icon button (icon.secondary → text.default, transparent → fill.neutralHover).

progress.$description: Auto-dismiss timer bar along the bottom edge, tinted to the role's accent over a faint track. Height is a baked 3px (a hairline meter, off the spacing grid). Combines with any trailing button.

global.$description: The app-wide solid bar — full-bleed, a solid status fill with dark text/icon, title + subtitle + close. Moved here from Alert (it is a docked notification, not an inline banner). Warning only this pass; solid negative/positive need the deferred text.forLabelBg to pick dark-vs-white text legibly.

text.$description: Dark text on the bright gold fill (surface-0).
